To: repo:cloud#1
Re: 6764764601 · security · GHSA-mm5x-r83w-8599 · merged in #32175 (`2ff26aabf6`), advisory closed

The host seam is on `main`. It is `EmailServicePlugin`'s `smtpConnect` option, and it applies to every SMTP transport the plugin builds. An admitted connection must hand back the host's own socket. While the option is set, `transportOptions` keys that pick another connection or transport kind are refused. The option is documented in `packages/plugins/plugin-email/README.md`. Once the cloud pin moves past `2ff26aabf6`, switch the hosted runtime's guard to the option and drop the prototype wrapper. It is not released yet.
